svg.title: The Tesseract NPU core
svg.desc: Stylized die of tsr_core: four MVM clusters of 128 MACs at the corners, each next to its own DDR4 channel and memory arbiter; the 4 MiB SPM with even and odd banks in the center, with the x broadcast / y gather to the clusters; the control core (Ibex RV32IMC, ITCM and DTCM), the debug module, the issue path with unit queues, the vector unit, the DMA (LD, ST, KVST), QACT and the CSR block. The host reaches the CSR port over PCIe and XRT with a launch queue and a completion ring. One cluster is opened up: weight streamer, unpack, activation buffer, 128 MAC lanes (with the attention modes ATTQK and ATTPV), fp accumulate and tree16.
